category_title: Students focused on learning and demonstrating ability with relatively effective self-regulation
scenario_title: Grammar quiz and social comparison distraction
minimal_context: The student is taking a well-structured grammar quiz during a whole-class language arts lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please begin the grammar quiz. The questions are straightforward, so just write your answers on the paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Okay, I'm starting now. I really want to get the highest score in the class on this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do your best on the questions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks around the room) Wait, is everyone else already done with the first section? They look like they are writing faster than me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep working on your own quiz.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't even focus on my own questions anymore. I keep watching to see who is finishing before me, and I'm too worried about my grade compared to theirs to keep reading.

task.content: Grammar quiz with clear and straightforward questions and answers

context.materials: Grammar quiz that was very well-structured

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When encountering difficulties in regulating attention away from comparison with others
